description: Presentation inventory for bin/fm-doctor.sh. Each check names an existing owner's fact (a bootstrap line prefix, a bare token, or a read-only owner verb) and says how to show it: area, severity, and a fix hint. Detection stays with the owners; bin/fm-doctor.sh validates this file; bin/fm-lint.sh checks that every line prefix the emitters (and the bin/ libraries they source) can print is mapped here, and that every owner exists.

startup-network-report.complete: ^completed off the startup path in [^:]*: GitHub authentication,

checks.fix: Ask the captain, then run bin/fm-bootstrap.sh install <tool> (the line names the install command).
Give the captain the printed instructions URL; never pass the tool to bin/fm-bootstrap.sh install.
Work in plain text; install or upgrade lavish-axi with captain consent before using Lavish.
Restore the pinned build named in config/tool-provenance (a plain reinstall replaced it), or drop the pin once the upstream release carries the change.
Correct config/backend or FM_BACKEND to one of the listed backends before dispatching.
Fix the named problem in config/crew-dispatch.json; do not dispatch by profile until it validates.
Correct config/startup-memory-budget; the memory/budget check reads it on demand.
No action; restart the watcher only when a cadence change must apply immediately.
Give the captain the exact allow rule the line names for the home's .claude/settings.local.json; a present rule does not prove auto mode honors it.
Install the named agent or remove it from the agent: list (ask the captain before editing their no-mistakes config); confirm with no-mistakes doctor.
Confirm the network is reachable, then ask the captain to run: ! gh auth login
The session holding the fleet lock restores the primary to its default branch as the line says.
Follow the bootstrap-diagnostics skill for the named variant; never delete backlog-close records by hand.
Reproduce with bin/fm-home-summary-refresh.sh (no --best-effort) and fix the reported failure.
Keep the outbox; rerun bin/fm-backlog-handoff.sh --resume-pending once the route is fixed.
No action unless the fact says an interrupted cleanup may have left an endpoint or local copy.
A STUCK clone needs hands-on attention; a skip is one-off unless it names the registry entry.
Inspect the reason; the second mate's instructions or inherited settings may be stale.
Investigate the reason; the second mate is not guaranteed to be running.
Keep the pending marker; fix the endpoint and rerun session start to retry the re-read nudge.
Keep the retry records; fix the named problem and rerun session start to resend the re-read instruction.
Rerun the command the line prints; the named checks are unknown, not failed.
Start or resume a firstmate session for this home and keep its supervision cycle live.
Read bin/fm-startup-network.sh report and rerun the command it names.
Correct config/firstmate-role as docs/configuration.md "Firstmate role" describes.

Set config/crew-harness to a verified adapter, or leave it absent to use this session's harness.
